config.label: Base URL of the Jira Data Center instance
config.description: Base URL of the Jira Data Center instance

config.label: Personal Access Token for standard operations
config.description: Personal Access Token for standard operations

config.label: Personal Access Token for elevated/admin operations (optional)
config.description: Personal Access Token for elevated/admin operations (optional)

config.label: Timeout in milliseconds for every Jira API call
config.description: Timeout in milliseconds for every Jira API call. Defaults to 30000 (30s) when unset or blank; raise it if your instance is slow.

config.label: Comma-separated tool domains to pre-activate at startup instead of the core-issues default (core-issues, jsm-service-desk, assets, issue-detail, agile, projects, filters-personal-settings, users-groups-permissions, admin)
config.description: Comma-separated tool domains to pre-activate at startup instead of the core-issues default (core-issues, jsm-service-desk, assets, issue-detail, agile, projects, filters-personal-settings, users-groups-permissions, admin). Unknown names are warned about on stderr and ignored.

config.label: Comma-separated tool domains allowed to substitute JIRA_ADMIN_TOKEN via token escalation
config.description: Comma-separated tool domains allowed to substitute JIRA_ADMIN_TOKEN via token escalation. Empty by default — no tool may escalate until its domain is listed here.

config.label: Optional Jira DC account username (not a PAT), paired with JIRA_SESSION_PASSWORD, enabling session-cookie auth for the legacy avatar upload/crop/finalize tools
config.description: Optional Jira DC account username (not a PAT), paired with JIRA_SESSION_PASSWORD, enabling session-cookie auth for the legacy avatar upload/crop/finalize tools. Must be the same account as JIRA_USER_TOKEN and must not be an administrator: those tools authenticate as this account rather than the token.

config.label: Password for JIRA_SESSION_USERNAME
config.description: Password for JIRA_SESSION_USERNAME. Only used to establish a session cookie for the legacy avatar upload/crop/finalize tools.
